_doc: Xuyên Lâm Môn's Effect engine records (world-depth Stage 6; ADR-0009). Input to tools/design/combat_sim/put_effects.py, which merges them into assets/data/combat_effects.json under source world-depth:xuyen_lam. Unpriced. Every Effect declares all counters it reads or writes for standalone GDScript compilation.

The Long Road.rule: Staff Canon of the Calmed Wind and Waves (passive art, layer 5, authored wish d23): While you are Pressing, your arts cost 5 % less linh lực, and a further 1 % less for each Walk Slowly stack you hold.
The Long Road.approx: Uses live always-on additive cost_red (0.05 base + 0.01 per walk_slowly stack, bounded by engine cost_red_cap 0.95) instead of compounding 1 % off remaining cost; practically identical at normal Walk Slowly stack counts and never reaches zero cost.

Do Not Listen.rule: Heart That Does Not Listen to the Rain (passive art, layer 1): A passive ward: incoming soul damage is reduced by 15 % and charm resistance is raised by 20 %; each soul hit, song hit or pulse under Charm raises the ward by 1 stack (+5 % soul resistance and +5 % charm resistance each), and the raise fades by a tenth each second.
Do Not Listen.approx: Uses decay_share: 0.1 on unheeding_ward (fades 10 % every pulse, including the pulse it was raised). Raises on soul_taken, was_hit (tags: [song]), and pulse while own.status.charmed >= 1 (engine has no status_taken event on the target).

Rain on the Leaves.rule: Founder's Bamboo Staff: While you keep Pressing, the foe's art that hits you gives you one Walk Slowly stack, as if you had walked a second longer.

Lamp on the Road.rule: Guide's Lamp: The foe cannot be unseen (+20 accuracy for the fight). Once per fight, your first escape art costs no linh lực and your escape chance is raised by 50.
Lamp on the Road.approx: One-on-one fight.py has no stealth/unseen state: 'cannot be unseen' grants +20 acc for the fight, and 'leave at no cost once per fight' waives the first escape-tagged art's cost via next_art_cost: 0.0 and grants +50 escape chance (a holder without an escape art never auto-flees).

Step Before the Strike.rule: Son of Thủ Lôi Bảo, full set (2 pieces): each time you evade, your next staff strike cannot be blocked and lands an additional Lightning shock worth 30 % of its damage.
Step Before the Strike.approx: Engine has no live damage-conversion mod (convert is static on ArtDef). Approximates '30 % of its damage as Lightning' by keeping the full unblocked staff strike (1 ms ignore_block: 1 on staff art_fired, since defend reads ignore_block with ctx=None) and adding a Lightning shock (return_damage share: 0.30, dtype: lightning) on staff hit_landed so Walk Slowly stacks and crits still scale it cleanly.

The Lamp Does Not Go Out.rule: The Lamp and the Road, full set (2 pieces): each hit you evade keeps the lamp lit for 3 more seconds, and while it is lit you regenerate 1 % of your health each second. Below a quarter of your health the lamp lights itself, and the regeneration doubles (2 % of your health each second).
